headline: Find out why you don't close
subhead: A Claude system that reads any sales-call transcript and shows you the exact moment the deal slipped — scored against your own best closes, not a generic framework.
subhead_secondary: Paste a transcript, get the objection you missed and the one follow-up line to send next.
inside: A Claude skill that ingests your call transcript
Flags the exact spot an objection went unhandled
Scores the call against your own best closes, not some generic framework
Hands you the one follow-up line to send next
proof: Built from real agency work. I build automation systems for $1–10M service firms — this is the exact setup I run, not a theory deck.
